faqs.q: How fast can I move in?
faqs.a: Most rooms are next-day move-in once you're approved, and approval is usually quick. If a room is available and you apply early enough in the day, same-day move-in is often possible too.

faqs.q: How does the process work?
faqs.a: It's simple: apply, get approved by both PadSplit and our host team (usually the same day), pay your first week's rent, get your door code, and move in!

faqs.q: What happens after I'm approved?
faqs.a: You pay your first week's rent to lock in the room, then get your move-in details and door code. From there you can move in right away — most homes are ready immediately.

faqs.q: What does it cost to move in?
faqs.a: Just a $19 application fee to apply — and it's refunded if you're not approved. Once you're approved, your first week's rent is due to move in. There's no big security deposit.

faqs.q: How does payment work and when is rent due?
faqs.a: Rent is paid weekly, in advance. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that it's charged automatically on the same weekday each week through PadSplit, using a linked bank account or card. Utilities and WiFi are included, so there are no separate bills.

faqs.q: Can I pay monthly?
faqs.a: Rent is billed weekly, in advance — that's how our billing works, so there isn't a monthly option. Your first week is due when you move in, and after that you're charged automatically on the same weekday each week. If weekly doesn't fit your schedule, you can ask us about paying bi-weekly instead.

faqs.q: Are there any other fees or hidden costs?
faqs.a: No hidden costs. Your weekly rent covers the room, all utilities, and WiFi. The only upfront items are the $19 application fee and your first week's rent. (Optional extras like double occupancy cost a little more.)

faqs.q: What do I need to get approved?
faqs.a: You'll need income of at least 2x the rent, and no felonies, violent misdemeanors, or evictions in the past 7 years. You're approved by both PadSplit's background screening and our host team — usually the same day.

faqs.q: Do you check credit?
faqs.a: There's no minimum credit score. Approval is based on a background screening and proof you earn at least 2x the rent — not a traditional credit check.

faqs.q: How do I show proof of income?
faqs.a: During your application you can upload recent pay stubs, a bank statement, or an offer letter. We generally look for income of about 2x the rent, and the application walks you through exactly what to provide.

faqs.q: How long does approval take?
faqs.a: Usually quick — often the same day. You're approved by both PadSplit's background screening (which runs automatically with your application) and our host team.

faqs.q: What if I'm not approved?
faqs.a: If you're not approved, your $19 application fee is refunded. You're welcome to apply to another home that might be a better fit.

faqs.q: Is the room furnished? What's in it?
faqs.a: Yes — every room comes fully furnished, typically with a bed, mattress, and storage, and the shared spaces like the kitchen and living room are furnished too. You just bring your personal belongings.

faqs.q: Is it a private room?
faqs.a: Yes, you get your own private bedroom with its own lock. Spaces like the kitchen, living room, and most bathrooms are shared with your housemates.

faqs.q: Do rooms have private bathrooms?
faqs.a: Some rooms have a private bathroom and others share — it's listed on each room. Private-bath rooms cost a bit more and tend to go quickly.

faqs.q: What's included in the price?
faqs.a: Your furnished room, all utilities, WiFi, and shared common areas — one weekly payment, no separate bills.

faqs.q: Can I use the kitchen and cook?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every home has a shared, fully-equipped kitchen you're free to use, along with shared living spaces.

faqs.q: Is there laundry?
faqs.a: Yes — every home has a washer and dryer on site, included at no extra cost.

faqs.q: Is there parking?
faqs.a: Yes — there's a carport and street parking right in front of the house, so you'll always have a spot.

faqs.q: How many people share a bathroom?
variants: How many people am I sharing the bathroom with?
faqs.a: You're typically sharing with 2 to 4 people. Everyone's on different schedules and cleans up after themselves, so we really don't get complaints about the shared bathrooms.

faqs.q: How many people live in each home?
variants: How many people does the house fit?
faqs.a: Our homes are over 2,500 sq ft across multiple floors, with standard-size bedrooms (10x12 and larger). They comfortably fit up to 8 residents, each in their own private room.

faqs.q: Can I tour a home before booking?
faqs.a: You can take a full virtual tour of most homes — every room and common area is shown through photos and a 3D walkthrough on each listing, so you can explore it all online before booking. In-person visits aren't available until after you book, since the exact address stays private until then. And if you move in and aren't happy with your home, transferring to another one is simple and free.

faqs.q: What are the house rules?
faqs.a: Our homes run on a simple philosophy: be here and be happy. A few shared agreements keep everyone comfortable — it's residents only (no guests), smoke-free indoors (step outside to smoke or vape), and pet-free. Quiet hours are 9 PM–9 AM. Keep shared spaces tidy and wash your dishes right after using them, bring your own basics like toilet paper and soap, treat the home and furnishings with care, and be a good neighbor — resolve things kindly and report anything that needs fixing through PadSplit. Ask our assistant if you'd like more detail on anything.

faqs.q: Can I have guests or overnight visitors?
faqs.a: No — guests aren't allowed in the homes at any time, day or night. Everyone living there is vetted and background-checked, which keeps the community safe and comfortable for residents.

faqs.q: Is smoking allowed?
faqs.a: No smoking or vaping inside the homes. If you smoke, it needs to be outdoors — preferably in the backyard.

faqs.q: Are animals allowed?
faqs.a: No, our homes are pet-free. To find a home for you and your furry friend, search here. (Registered service animals are considered separately, case by case.)

faqs.q: Can two people share a room?
faqs.a: Most rooms are single-occupancy. Some homes allow double occupancy for an additional fee — you can search for rooms that allow double occupancy here. (Bringing a child? Some homes allow it for a fee — use the same search to find family-friendly homes.)

faqs.q: Are the homes men, women, or mixed?
faqs.a: Most are mixed-gender co-living homes. You can browse what's available across our homes right on the site.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum stay or long-term commitment?
variants: Do I have to commit to 3 months?
faqs.a: We look for people who want to stick around long-term, but there's no lock-in — if something changes, you're free to transfer or move out whenever you need to.

faqs.q: What if I don't like it?
variants: What if it's not a good fit?
Can I leave if I want to?
What if I want to move out?
faqs.a: We want you somewhere you actually like living. If it's not working out, you can easily book a move-out — no hard feelings.

faqs.q: Can I switch rooms or homes later?
faqs.a: Yes — and it's simple and free. If you move in and aren't happy with your home, or you just want a change later, you can transfer to another available room or home at no cost. Just let us know when you're ready.

faqs.q: Where are the homes located?
faqs.a: We have homes across the Atlanta area — Decatur, South Atlanta, Stone Mountain, and Snellville. You can see each home's neighborhood on the map; the exact address is shared after you book.

faqs.q: How close is public transit?
faqs.a: It depends on the home — some are a short 5–10 minute walk to the bus, while others are better for residents who drive or rideshare. Ask our assistant about a specific home and we'll tell you.

faqs.q: Can I get mail and packages delivered?
variants: Can I use it as my mailing address?
faqs.a: Absolutely — it's your home. Use the address for mail, packages, whatever you need.

faqs.q: Is it safe?
faqs.a: Every resident is background-checked, and each room has its own electronic door lock for privacy and security.

faqs.q: Who handles maintenance or repairs?
faqs.a: If something needs fixing, submit a request through PadSplit and we'll take care of it. You're never on the hook for normal repairs.

faqs.q: Are the homes cleaned?
faqs.a: Shared common areas are cleaned regularly, and several homes include monthly cleaning of those spaces. You keep your own room tidy.

faqs.q: Do I need renters insurance?
faqs.a: It's not required, though you're welcome to insure your personal belongings if you'd like.

faqs.q: What is PadSplit and why do I book there?
faqs.a: PadSplit is the trusted platform we use to handle applications, screening, and secure weekly payments. When you tap “Book this room,” it takes you there to apply and pay for that exact room.

faqs.q: How do I get the exact address?
faqs.a: For residents' privacy, the exact street address is shared after you book. Each listing shows the neighborhood and a map area so you know where it is.
